result.title: Oddin: Latent Visual Reasoning in Unified Multimodal Models via Self-Distillation from Image Generation
result.summary: Unified large multimodal models (ULMMs) are able to perform visual reasoning through interleaved text-image generation, but generating explicit intermediate images incurs significant computational overhead. While visual latent reasoning addresses this, most existing methods rely on vision-language models (VLMs) incapable of visual generation. We propose Oddin, a novel framework enabling latent visual reasoning in ULMMs. Oddin replaces intermediate images with compact latent tokens processed entirely by the understanding branch, reserving the generation branch for the final output image. We train the model via offline self-distillation with three objectives, final image generation losses, text distillation losses, and cross-entropy losses for special tokens. Oddin surpasses interleaved generation baselines and closed-source VLMs on average across seven VBVR-Pro visual reasoning tasks. Qualitative analysis reveals that latent tokens attend to relevant regions in an input image, demonstrating that ULMMs can perform complex visual reasoning without generating intermediate images.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 Oddin 框架，在统一多模态模型中用理解分支处理紧凑的 latent token 替代中间图像，从而进行潜空间视觉推理，并通过离线自蒸馏的三个目标（最终图像生成、文本蒸馏、特殊 token 交叉熵）训练模型，在七个 VBVR-Pro 视觉推理任务上平均超过交错生成基线与闭源 VLM。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接研究 LVR：将中间视觉推理状态压缩为 latent token 而非显式图像，其「理解分支承担推理、生成分支仅出最终图」的分工与自蒸馏监督方式，可供核查视觉细节是否保留在 latent 中、latent 内容是否真正被答案使用。
